title: Planning hearing notices outside newspapers in Bill 85
summary: A committee member moved on September 29 to approve a report on Bill 85 (2026), but the vote is not in the recording. The bill would let Planning Commission hearing notices run in any suitable publication circulated across Maui County, not only a newspaper. Planning staff said the change would save the county money, and one caller asked that notices also be posted on county bulletin boards.
